title: Diffusion models for eye-gaze trajectory generation using position and velocity representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.05522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Eye-tracking data are expensive to collect, requiring specialized hardware and controlled laboratory conditions, and difficult to share because of privacy constraints. We address this using two complementary denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) for unconditional generation of eye-gaze dynamics from visual-search data. Both use an identical FiLM-conditioned one-dimensional U-Net with self-attention (19.35,M parameters), trained on 8,s sliding-window sequences from 28 participants. One model generates raw two-dimensional gaze-position sequences, while the other generates two-component velocity sequences; each uses representation-specific preprocessing, training settings, data partitions, and evaluation protocols. Both are evaluated across three independent training seeds, with aggregated metrics reported as mean,$\pm$,SD. The position-space model achieves a mean Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence of $0.016\pm0.004$ across nine ki

translated_title: 基于位置与速度表示的眼动注视轨迹生成扩散模型
translated_abstract: 眼动追踪数据的采集成本高昂，需要专门的硬件和受控的实验室条件，且由于隐私限制而难以共享。为此，我们采用两个互补的去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），从视觉搜索数据中无条件生成眼动注视动态。两个模型均使用相同的带自注意力机制的FiLM条件一维U-Net（1935万参数），并在28名参与者的8秒滑动窗口序列上训练。其中一个模型生成原始的二维注视位置序列，另一个模型生成双分量速度序列；每个模型均使用针对其表示形式定制的预处理方法、训练设置、数据划分和评估协议。两者均在三个独立训练种子上进行评估，汇总指标以均值±标准差的形式报告。位置空间模型在九个（原文此处截断）上实现了0.016±0.004的平均Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度。
tldr: 提出两个互补的去噪扩散概率模型，分别基于位置表示和速度表示无条件生成眼动注视轨迹，从而低成本地合成保护隐私的眼动追踪数据。
en_tdlr: Proposes two complementary denoising diffusion probabilistic models that unconditionally generate eye-gaze trajectories using position and velocity representations, enabling low-cost synthesis of privacy-preserving eye-tracking data.
